name: SamplingCollection Feature
abstract: OMS alignment: `sosa:SamplingCollection` is a SOSA/SSN generalization with no direct ISO 19156 (OMS) counterpart; OMS defines no dedicated sampling-collection requirement class. See the OMS alignment building block (`ogc.sosa.oms-alignment`). This building block defines the set of a GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing a SOSA SamplingCollection - a collection of one or more Samplings, whose members share a common value for one or more properties.
